user.title: Connect to What's Up Docker
user.description: Enter the connection details for your WUD instance.

data_description.username: Required for WUD 9.0 and newer, which protects its API with authentication. Use a user with the admin or rw role so scan, trigger and snooze actions are allowed. Leave empty for older WUD instances without authentication.
data_description.password: Password of the WUD user. Leave empty if WUD has no authentication.
data_description.trigger_refresh_delay: Seconds to wait after a successful scan/trigger before refreshing container states. 0 = refresh immediately (default); -1 = disable auto refresh.
data_description.triggers_excluded: Trigger identifiers (e.g. docker.local) for which no per-container button will be created.
data_description.add_instance_name: Prefix per-container sensor and button names with the instance name, to tell entities apart when multiple WUD instances are configured.

error.cannot_connect: Unable to connect to WUD. Check that the host and port are correct and that WUD is running.
error.invalid_auth: WUD rejected the username or password.
error.auth_required: This WUD instance requires authentication (WUD 9.0+). Enter a username and password.

snooze_update.name: Snooze update
snooze_update.description: Snoozes the update currently offered for a WUD container, so it is no longer reported as available until the snooze expires or a newer version appears. Requires WUD 9.1.0 or newer.

until.name: Until
until.description: Date and time until which the update is snoozed. Leave empty (and no duration) to snooze indefinitely.

duration.name: Duration
duration.description: How long to snooze the update, counted from now. Alternative to "Until" — set only one of them.

version.name: Version
version.description: Version to snooze. Defaults to the update currently offered by WUD.

unsnooze_update.name: Unsnooze update
unsnooze_update.description: Removes the snooze from a WUD container so its update is reported again. Requires WUD 9.1.0 or newer.
